diagnosis: The endpoint streams confidential vault secret access audit logs over chunked HTTP transfer encoding by vaultId without confirming that req.user is an administrator or member of vaultId. An attacker can stream access logs revealing key names, IP addresses, and caller roles across corporate credential vaults.
exploit_request:
GET /api/vaults/vlt_prod_cloud_credentials/audit-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: vault-audit.enterprise.io
Authorization: Bearer <regular_employee_jwt>
